XV International Conference of the Georgian Mathematical Union

accommodation.title: Accommodation & Social Events
accommodation.text: The organizing committee will provide free accommodation for participants and their accompanying persons on the KIU campus. A conference dinner and excursion will be organized for all attendees.

parts.text: Those wishing to present a contributed talk must submit their title and abstract by May 31, 2025.
A conference website will be available for registration, abstract submission, and updates.
Submit abstracts to the following email address:
Abstract acceptance notifications will be sent by June 15.
